title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the Agreement establishing an association between the European Union and the Principality of Andorra and the Republic of San Marino respectively
part_text: 14. Recalls that the Principality of Monaco had been officially engaged in the negotiation of an association agreement with the EU, along with Andorra and San Marino, since 2015; takes note of the suspension of negotiations with Monaco; respects Monaco’s sovereign decision in this regard and underlines that the EU should neither interfere with nor exert pressure on Monaco regarding the possible resumption of negotiations;
